version.author: Michal MaXyM Bartak
version.changelog: The script now installs to Scripts/MXM Scripts/MXM_ListOfInstrumentsAndEffects/ instead of Scripts/MXM Scripts/Various/, so the installed tree matches the repository. ReaPack moves the file for you, but REAPER identifies an action by its path: toolbar buttons, keyboard shortcuts and custom actions bound to the old location must be pointed at the new one after updating.

version.author: Michal MaXyM Bartak
version.changelog:
The window is rewritten on ReaImGui. The old one was drawn with Lokasenna's GUI library v2, which knows nothing about display scaling and so came out blurry and undersized on a HiDPI screen; the new one is sharp at any resolution and can be resized. Install **ReaImGui** from ReaPack before updating. Lokasenna's GUI library is no longer required, and neither is SWS -- the clipboard now goes through ReaImGui.
Plugins on media items are counted. REAPER lets a take carry its own FX chain, instruments included, and none of it was reported before: a project driven by a take instrument listed no instrument at all. FX on the active take are counted as instruments or effects like any others, and FX on the other takes are listed under offline/inactive, since they do not play.
Record input FX are counted, in a new **Input FX** section. Only the master track's input chain -- the monitoring chain -- was read before, so input FX on ordinary tracks were invisible.
The window has an ⓘ button: the version you are running, the author, the licence, and links to the documentation and the source.
The report no longer goes stale between clicks: it refreshes itself when the project changes or you switch project tab. It also follows the project you are actually looking at, where before the track list was read from whichever project was open when the script started.
